subject: Follow-up: PoC deployment mode & trial plan — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Follow-up: PoC deployment mode & trial plan — Acme Corp

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand Acme's goals for the pilot. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the PoC plan: 

Recap:
- Primary objective: validate integration of Redwood inference into Acme search/QA flow and confirm SLOs for latency and cost.
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool), Private VPC/on-prem (security/data residency).
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Platform/Infra (networking), Security (SOC2 & SSO), Procurement/Legal for contracts.

Proposed PoC options (we can pick one to start):
1) Hosted API trial (2 weeks) — fastest to start, no infra changes, good for early validation.
2) Dedicated trial (4 weeks reserved capacity) — more realistic for predictable throughput and network isolation.
3) Private VPC evaluation (6+ weeks) — required if strict data residency/KMS controls are mandatory.

To make a recommendation, can you confirm the following by EOD Wednesday?
- Expected peak QPS and average request size (tokens)
- Whether PII or regulated data will be sent during the PoC
- List of stakeholders for security and procurement (names + emails)

I've attached a short PoC checklist that outlines requirements for each mode (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf). Once we have the details above, Marissa and Ben will propose a concrete timeline and success criteria.

Thanks — happy to jump back on a quick 20 min call to finalize.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf

- Peak expected QPS: ~8 requests/s; average payload ~450 tokens in / 550 tokens out.

- Stakeholders: 
  - Priya Desai (Head of Product) — priya.desai@acme-corp.com (cc'd)

  - Lina Gomez (Security) — lina.gomez@acme-corp.com

Initial preference: start with a Hosted API 2-week trial to validate integration quickly. If latency/throughput needs require it, we'll evaluate Dedicated next.

Would like to see proposed success criteria and a kickoff time-slot next week.

Best,
Sam

Subject: PoC checklist & proposed success criteria (Hosted API path)

Hi Sam / Priya —

Following Jordan's note, attached is our PoC checklist (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf) and a starter set of success criteria for a Hosted API 2-week trial. Highlights: 

Proposed success criteria (Hosted API, 2 weeks):
- Functional: End-to-end integration with your search pipeline and < 1% error rate for inference requests.
- Latency: 95th percentile single-token latency < 200ms; end-to-end request 95p < 400ms.
- Throughput: sustain 8 QPS with p95 latency targets met.
- Quality: No significant regression on your evaluation prompts (we'll run a 50-prompt sanity check).
- Observability: Access to request/latency/cost logs for the PoC period.

Pre-reqs from Acme for Hosted PoC:
- Provide sample traffic (anonymized) and a service account for API key management.
- Confirm firewall egress rules (URL whitelist) or let us know if you need private peering.
- Security contact for a quick SOC2/SSO checklist (we can share our SAML config).

If you want to pursue Dedicated instead, the checklist includes minimal infra changes and an expected 1\u20132 week lead for capacity reservation. Private VPC will add ~4\u20136 weeks to provision (security & networking dependent).

Next steps: confirm Hosted trial and provide sample traffic + security contact. I can draft a kickoff agenda once we have dates.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Sam —

Appreciate the timeline. Summary of the plan we propose given your constraints: 

Starter PoC (Hosted API):
- Duration: 2 weeks (kickoff week of Feb 22).
- Traffic: mirror a representative sample at ~8 QPS, avg 450 tokens in / 550 tokens out.
- Success criteria (final): 
  - End-to-end 95p latency < 350ms (per Priya's ask).
  - 99% usable responses on your 50-prompt evaluation set.
  - Observability: we will provide dashboards and a daily summary of cost & latency.

If Hosted fails to meet targets due to network or tail-latency, we will propose a Dedicated trial (4 weeks) with reserved capacity and improved isolation. Dedicated lead time ~1 week.

Action items before kickoff:
- Acme: share anonymized sample traffic + SSO contact + procurement contact (Tom).
- Redwood: send SSO questionnaire and short trial terms / statement of work (SOW).

I've attached the SSO questionnaire spreadsheet for Lina (redwood-sso-questions.xlsx). Once we have sign-off from procurement, Jordan can schedule kickoff and share the DocuSign link for the trial SOW.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
